authority: User instruction + frozen contracts + independent verification; Jev is an evidence-bound judgment signal.

capabilities.title: 技能评测后端的资格及退化拒绝

bootstrap_authority: External independent Verifier using frozen evidence; not a retrospective product receipt.
required_runtime_invariants: Reference existence, same project, fixed revision/hash and independent reviewer identity checked server-side.
All G01-G07 IDs exactly once; PASS evidence verified, NOT_APPLICABLE rationale independently accepted; FAIL/NOT_RUN cannot adopt.
Selected candidate belongs to frozen candidates and its actual source revision matches; raw model options cannot invent a candidate.
BOUNDED_AUTO requires current matching reuse_selection Qualification; Jev cannot grant tools, publish or sign acceptance.
Rejected/deferred decisions do not produce implementation ReuseDecisionPayload or mutate stable code.
Product ADOPT binds actual baseline/candidate Experiment evidence and an independently accepted decision; inspection/trials stay isolated.
Legacy ReuseDecisionPayload fields and decision must agree with adopted strategy, selected source and evidence.

skill_up.invocation: Pinned CLI subprocess + original result.json/event JSONL; no external import of internal Go packages.
skill_up.report_mapping: One existing EvaluationReport per frozen variant x iteration; immutable Artifact indexes all expected dimensions.
skill_up.fallback: Existing qualified backend with the same frozen checks; missing resources are BLOCKED, not evidence of tool failure.
